steps.name: Perceber
steps.task: Restate the goal and name the input files.

steps.name: Preparar a entrada
steps.task: Check the input image or mesh against the skill: clean background, framing, scale.

steps.name: Executar
steps.task: Give the exact headless command and run it.

steps.name: Medir
steps.task: Measure faces before and after, watertight, dimensions in mm and offenders per category.

steps.name: Relatório
steps.task: Report the result. When something failed, name the phase, the cause and the fix, in that order.
